low_connectivity_surface_label: Example State official voter-information low-connectivity and reduced-data fail-open policy
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes remain readable and recoverable on slow, fragile, or explicitly reduced-data network conditions rather than assuming a comfortably fast, steady connection.
critical_answer_in_initial_response_note: The current first-party answer/help lane remains readable before heavy media, maps, widgets, or noncritical follow-on requests complete.
maps_media_widgets_optional_note: Maps, media players, rich embeds, and other high-transfer helpers stay subordinate to a text-first answer lane rather than becoming the sole carrier of the official answer.
reduced_data_preference_handling_note: Reduced-data handling may trim decoration, transfer cost, or update frequency, but it does not silently change the underlying authoritative answer.
intermittent_secondary_request_failure_n: If secondary requests stall or fail, the route still exposes bounded official answer/help content instead of a spinner-only shell.
retry_refresh_user_guidance_note: When refresh or retry may help, the page gives bounded user guidance without hiding already-known official text behind indefinite loading states.
lightweight_help_contact_note: A visible first-party help/contact lane remains available even when rich assets or widgets do not load cleanly.
same_answer_across_network_variants_note: The office reviews weak-network and reduced-data routes to confirm they preserve the same authoritative answer rather than a stale or second-class substitute.
